submitted.rationale: Index 8 (In0.77Sb0.23) gave the highest measured EQE (0.40%). XRD shows it is a two-phase mix: the InSbO4-type rutile phase (Q≈2.79) is dominant, with a lot of bixbyite In2O3 (Q≈2.15, 3.5). The Sb-rich/stoichiometric film was single-phase rutile and scored lower (0.105%). The more In-rich film was dominated by In2O3 and also scored lower (0.127%). This suggests EQE peaks at a mixed-phase composition near index 8.

rejected.reason: Single-phase rutile like index 17 per XRD, so expected to be low; not measured
